warningLines: Horns on the night wind — riders under a pale moon. To the walls! They come in {count} heartbeats of {seconds}.
Dust on the border roads and a horn through the pines. {count} raiders, {seconds} breaths out. Light the lamps.
The watchfire gutters — hoofbeats past the treeline. {count} coming, {seconds} to bar the doors.
attackLines: They are over the fence! Wave {wave}, {count} strong — stand together!
victoryLines: The bell rings long — the Manner stands. {kills} fell, their pouches ours (+{loot} gold). Mend what broke.
Quiet again. {kills} raiders down, +{loot} gold in salvage. Oil the hinges and reset the traps.
defeatLines: The hall is ash and the bell is silent. Take the salvage wood and raise the beams again at dawn.
They broke the manor and melted into the trees. Salvage what you can — the village rises again.

enemyFactions.name: Thornband
enemyFactions.lore: Hungry woodland outlaws probe every unguarded road. Quick scouts fall easily to towers.

enemyFactions.name: Pale Host
enemyFactions.lore: Silent bowmen follow the mist. Close the distance before their arrows wear down the watch.

enemyFactions.name: Cinder Clan
enemyFactions.lore: Iron mauls hammer the gates. Slow breakers punish weak walls; layered defenses buy time.

enemyFactions.name: Ember Legion
enemyFactions.lore: The Cinder Clan's war-engine made flesh: rams for the gates, bombard-shells from afar. Kill the engines first.

enemyFactions.name: Pale Court
enemyFactions.lore: The Pale Host grown into a court: disciplined, gilded, merciless. Elites walk among them, and sometimes the Queen herself.

technologies.name: Moon orchards
technologies.text: Cultivate a dependable new food source.

technologies.name: Village medicine
technologies.text: Train the choir and establish a recovery bell.

technologies.name: Stone construction
technologies.text: Replace exposed timber with stone defenses.

technologies.name: Master engineering
technologies.text: Equip your builders for large projects.

technologies.name: Defensive fieldcraft
technologies.text: Prepare traps and better melee weapons.

technologies.name: Organized watch
technologies.text: Hold the perimeter with signal defenses and heavy weapons.

technologies.name: Runic forging
technologies.text: Improve the tools of smiths and armorers.

technologies.name: Metalworking
technologies.text: Recruit smelters to turn the workshop economy toward plate.

technologies.name: Education
technologies.text: Open a school and recruit apprentices.

technologies.name: Frontier commerce
technologies.text: Bring markets and specialist traders to town.

technologies.name: Deep woodcraft
technologies.text: Train specialists for the cold woods.

technologies.name: Waterway maps
technologies.text: Recruit divers and equip them for new expeditions.

hotspots.name: Stillwater
hotspots.text: The water is older than the Manor. Wren says the dark surface is honest: draw too hard from the land and even Stillwater will show the cost.

hotspots.name: Timber Line
hotspots.text: Old tax cuts still scar the boundary trees. Joren's tollmen are gone, but the line remains—a reminder that roads remember who charged for passage.

hotspots.name: Moonwell
hotspots.text: Moonstone dust shines in the mortar around the old well. The Mooncleric calls it borrowed light, never a miracle.

hotspots.name: Starwatch Ridge
hotspots.text: Sorrel's chalk marks survive on the high stones: horn counts, wind arrows, and the names of watchmen who stood here through nights too long to number.

hotspots.name: Whisperwood
hotspots.text: The pines carry sound farther than they should. Wayfinders leave paired cuts on safe trunks so travelers can tell an echo from a road.

hotspots.name: Ashfall March
hotspots.text: Charcoal lies under the grass in black seams. Failed hearths once stood here; Sarella says the ground remembers every fire that was asked to burn too long.

hotspots.name: Blackwater Mouth
hotspots.text: Broken pilings vanish beneath the black current. Fishers still tie a white thread to the first post before crossing, a habit nobody admits is a prayer.

hotspots.name: Southreach Crossing
hotspots.text: Four old roads meet under one weathered marker. The Pale Envoy chose this place because every road arrives owing something to another.

hotspots.name: Dawnfields
hotspots.text: The field earned its name from a single pale morning after the Longest Night. Nobody claims the sun returned; they only remember that the dark finally thinned.

hotspots.name: Pale Coast
hotspots.text: Salt crusts the ruined steps above the tide. Grey-market sailors leave copper nails in the cracks for luck and take nothing from the water after midnight.
